column4: go build of the real binary into a temp dir, isolated HOME/CBCTL_HOME and no CAPELLA_*: --version (stamped version + licence line), --help, guide topics (bundled), guide config clusters.deletionProtection (schema bundled), validate of a valid capella.yaml, init --non-interactive --dry-run (presets bundled) all exit 0; Go binaries need no runtime, so the PATH-without-Python part does not apply

real binary: invalid capella.yaml exits 3, unknown command exits 3, project list without credentials exits 3; no OS keychain: configure saves the profile, warns to use CAPELLA_API_KEY, exits 0 as capellactl did, and never echoes the key; binary-vs-installed comparison is PyInstaller-specific

POST /users body {name,credentialType:basic,access,password} returns id+password; list and get paths; GET returns the ETag and no password; PUT body is only {access} with If-Match from the ETag (CreateCredential now sends credentialType basic, as capellactl did)

exact method+path sequence for list/create/get scope, list/create/get/update/delete collection, delete scope; bodies {name}, {name,maxTTL:-1}, {maxTTL:-1}; update sends If-Match 3 from the collection ETag
a 429 then 200 logs '[warning] - retrying GET <path> (attempt 2/6) after 429' on stderr

runs on fake and sandbox without skip: source with bucket/scope/collection is cloned to another region, the clone plans clean (--detailed-exitcode 0), cluster get -o json shows region and healthy state, both deleted
credential created, plan clean, connectionString read; SDK KV connect with it on the sandbox (CAPELLA_SANDBOX_CLIENT_CIDR); only the SDK step is skipped on the fake, which has no data service

apply, re-apply zero writes, edit bucket memory + CIDR comment + hibernation timezone -> apply writes /buckets/, /allowedcidrs and /onOffSchedule -> re-apply converges with zero writes, destroy, project gone
schedule set, then apply reports 'No changes' with zero writes, --sunday 08:00-20:00 per-day update, pause/resume/delete
duplicate bucket, scope, collection, credential and CIDR each answer 409 with Capella code 1010 (fake now sends 1010)
every cbctl command in docs/capella/migrating-from-scale-script.md (>=5) parses with real flags and resolves to a runnable command
capella, single-node-dev, gcp-prod and azure-prod example snapshots exist and load

reference.md equals the schema-generated text (reference.Write check), contains deletionProtection, node.compute.cpu, hibernation.weekdays, memoryAllocationInMb, **immutable** and the API operation; Makefile docs/docs-check targets and check runs docs-check
each of the 20 day-2 task sections exists in docs/capella/runbook.md with its cbctl command in a bash block and a text output block (bucket/collection create are bucket/collection add in cbctl)

runbook intro names -y, --quiet and cbctl capella guide ci; CI/CD section has -y -q apply, CBCTL_QUIET=true, plan --detailed-exitcode, guide ci, 'no environment variable for approval' and exit 4 (runbook fixed from exit 1)
on the 1.0.0, 1.5.0 and 2.0.0 reports the breakdown groups add up to the spec total and the table is identical

operations not in 1.0.0 equal operations planned for 1.5.0; db-role create planned; 1.0.0 report links CAP-064
